items.title: Purity is preserved by a quasi-finite base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that purity along a fibre is preserved by a base change which is quasi-finite at the point (statement lines 4907-4914, tag 05L2-adjacent). The proof is short but complete: an impurity of the pulled back module with the morphism quasi-finite composes with the quasi-finite base change to give an impurity of the original module, and the characterization of purity by the non existence of impurities gives the conclusion. The translation of the impurity is the substance, so the claim is H2.
